title: Learning to Formalize: Bridging Open-Ended Workloads and Fast Decision Models

arXiv:2610.36595v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Decision models offer fast choices over sup- plied alternatives, while general-purpose large language models interpret open-ended tasks through flexible generation and reasoning at the cost of sequential decoding. Many work- loads expect a generative backend to determine what can be done and therefore provide no well-defined candidate list. We bridge this in- terface gap with a small candidate formalizer trained on offline teacher-generated lists.

title: Proactive Memory for Event-Driven LLM Agents
snippet:
arXiv:2610.36967v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Proactive LLM agents anticipate service opportunities from ongoing observations and accumulated history.
